claims: Mark Pope is the head coach of the Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball team.
Mark Pope was hired in April 2024 to lead the Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball program.
Mark Pope was a former captain of Kentucky's 1996 NCAA championship team.
Mark Pope played for Kentucky from 1994 to 1996.
Mark Pope served as head coach at BYU from 2019 to 2024.
Mark Pope served as head coach at Utah Valley from 2015 to 2019.
In March 2026, Mark Pope is guiding the Kentucky men's basketball team through the 2025-26 season.
John Calipari left for Arkansas after the 2023-24 season.
